text:
marta: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 503s and timeouts since the post-deploy at ~11:58 UTC. Saw first ticket from cust-842.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: r-2026-03-17-11:58 id=rl-8412 target=canary(us-west-2:5%)

raj: Observing 5xx spike in us-west-2 canary: 5xx rate ~8% -> 22% over 8m. Latency tail also increased. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/dash/rollouts

support-bot: Customer logs (cust-842) show repeated gateway timeouts and request-id=ci-0a9c. sample:
```
2026-03-17T11:59:12Z runtime-proxy error: upstream timeout after 2500ms req_id=ci-0a9c target=runtime-gnn-02
```

amanda: @raj any idea if the new bridge-prefetch flag could affect proxy/backpressure paths? we toggled it in canary with the deploy.

raj: Yes — the bridge-prefetch flag changes batching window and prefetch behavior. If kvcache misses spike, it increases upstream load and can surface as 504/503 at the gateway.

sre-oncall: Paging in. I'm putting the canary in read-only and starting a rollback of the bridge flag. Can someone grab the rollback command? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: To rollback the flag in canary run:
```
redwood rollout flag set --env=canary --flag=bridge-prefetch --value=off --metadata="rollback:post-deploy-503"
```
Rollback started by sre-oncall at 12:04 UTC.

raj: Running live traces for request-ids: ci-0a9c, ci-1b2d. I see a pattern: upstream runtime queue depth jumps right before timeout.

marta: Noted — I also see errors in telemetry: kvcache-miss-rate in canary jumped x7 after toggle. Suspect prefetch created hot key churn.

sre-oncall: Flag reverted, canary config back to previous. Re-deploy not required. Watching metrics now.

deploy-bot: Flag revert confirmed in canary at 12:07 UTC (rl-8412).

raj: 5xx rate in canary fell from 22% -> 1.5% within 3 minutes. Latency p95 trending back to baseline.

support-bot: Customer cust-842 updated. Sending incident number INC-2026-0441 and apology. Offering temporary traffic pin until fully verified.

amanda: Great response. Next steps: add a preflight that runs KV cache stress test for bridge-prefetch on canary before enabling, and a rollback playbook entry. I'll file a follow-up doc.

marta: Creating postmortem draft and assigning action items. Raw logs & traces attached to INC-2026-0441.

sre-oncall: Marking incident resolved after 30m observation with stable metrics. Closing channel but keep follow-ups in #postmortems.

marta: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
